computation: Record fitting/checkpoint time against the 290 seconds between the latest allowed validation label and the first assessment decision. This is a computation check with cached observations, not measured live ingestion latency.
controls_and_blends: Six frozen baselines/components, six new fits, and eight fixed 50/50 natural-posterior blends: each fine-tuned neural model with the original per-asset tree or the same-window morning tree. Apply all three prior policies to every procedure.
hypothesis: The original gradient-training cutoff is roughly 36 hours before noon. Already released same-day morning labels may improve a pretrained representation and a fresh tree without consuming any noon assessment outcomes.

information_and_partitions.assessment: Unchanged 12:02:00 <= decision < 13:59:50 and exactly the original 7070 rows per asset/date.
information_and_partitions.selection: Include epoch zero plus four fine-tuning epochs; select highest mean morning-validation balanced accuracy with full-morning training priors as the decision denominator, then lowest natural log loss. No assessment input is accepted by the fitting function.

interpretation: All five dates are already exposed; selection remains exploratory and cannot close the discovery gate. Keep the existing five-point balanced-accuracy target and require a separately registered fresh-date confirmation under the continuing nominal error budget.
loss_contract: Use morning equal-asset/class weighted CE on logits z + log(original recovery prior) - log(recent training prior). The ordinary forecaster continues to recover natural probabilities using its original prior. This leaves the initial natural forecast unchanged and preserves a consistent posterior contract after fine-tuning.
morning_tree_control: One pooled class-balanced HGB7 per morning window, with the frozen 200-iteration, 0.05-learning-rate, min-leaf-100, L2-10 settings. Recover its natural probabilities using its own morning training priors.

neural_settings.checkpoint: The frozen first-round pooled neural checkpoint for this assessment date.
neural_settings.features: Unchanged 95-column feature schema; do not use new event-clock observations in this recency study.
neural_settings.normalizer: Frozen original training quantiles and active-feature mask.

policy_contract: Registered means each old source original decision rule and the original blend rule for new procedures; morning_full uses the available 00:02-11:30 label frequencies for every procedure; forecast_3600 uses the previously fixed causal one-hour forecast marginal with already available same-day initialization.
